capabilities: number table body rows in the margin
add editable captions and footnotes stored as comment lines in the note
copy a table as a PNG image to the clipboard
copy a table as clean Markdown with caption and note
disambiguation: It does not edit or restructure table cells; it only annotates tables with rows numbers, captions and notes, and copies them out.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. If the clipboard is unavailable, copied PNGs are saved into the vault instead; captions and notes are read-only in embeds where the table cannot be matched to a note line.
problem: Markdown tables in Obsidian have no row numbers, nowhere to put a caption, and no easy way to hand a table to someone else without reformatting it by hand.
summary: Adds row numbers, editable captions and footnotes, and copy-as-image or copy-as-Markdown output to Markdown tables.
